records.key: Added {count} images to page {page}.
records.source: Added {count} images to page {page}.
records.translation: Se añadieron {count} imágenes a la página {page}.

records.key: Background subtraction
records.source: Background subtraction
records.translation: Sustracción de fondo

records.key: Channel the import settings below are edited for; All channels sets every channel at once.
records.source: Channel the import settings below are edited for; All channels sets every channel at once.
records.translation: Canal para el que se editan los ajustes de importación de abajo; Todos los canales ajusta todos los canales a la vez.

records.key: Check the pages, adjust any box, choose the DPI under Settings…, then export the PDF.
records.source: Check the pages, adjust any box, choose the DPI under Settings…, then export the PDF.
records.translation: Revise las páginas, ajuste cualquier recuadro, elija los DPI en Configuración… y luego exporte el PDF.

records.key: Close the export section; the settings section returns as it was.
records.source: Close the export section; the settings section returns as it was.
records.translation: Cierra la sección de exportación; la sección de ajustes vuelve como estaba.

records.key: Contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization of this channel.
records.source: Contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization of this channel.
records.translation: Ecualización adaptativa del histograma con limitación de contraste de este canal.

records.key: Deselect
records.source: Deselect
records.translation: Deseleccionar

records.key: Deselect all fields
records.source: Deselect all fields
records.translation: Deseleccionar todos los campos

records.key: Drag images from the plate, well or image views onto the page; press and hold an image, or use the Drag to canvas handle, when a plain drag would pan. Hold {keys} and click any image to add it. Image files can be dropped here from the file manager.
records.source: Drag images from the plate, well or image views onto the page; press and hold an image, or use the Drag to canvas handle, when a plain drag would pan. Hold {keys} and click any image to add it. Image files can be dropped here from the file manager.
records.translation: Arrastre imágenes desde las vistas de placa, pocillo o imagen a la página; mantenga pulsada una imagen, o use el control Arrastrar al lienzo, cuando un arrastre simple desplazaría la vista. Mantenga {keys} y haga clic en cualquier imagen para añadirla. Los archivos de imagen se pueden soltar aquí desde el gestor de archivos.

records.key: Drag this image onto the export canvas. You can also press and hold any image and then drag it, or hold {keys} and click an image to add it.
records.source: Drag this image onto the export canvas. You can also press and hold any image and then drag it, or hold {keys} and click an image to add it.
records.translation: Arrastre esta imagen al lienzo de exportación. También puede mantener pulsada cualquier imagen y arrastrarla, o mantener {keys} y hacer clic en una imagen para añadirla.

records.key: Drag to canvas
records.source: Drag to canvas
records.translation: Arrastrar al lienzo

records.key: Draw this channel; turn off to leave it out of the image.
records.source: Draw this channel; turn off to leave it out of the image.
records.translation: Dibuja este canal; desactívelo para omitirlo de la imagen.

records.key: Edit the page after this one.
records.source: Edit the page after this one.
records.translation: Edita la página siguiente a esta.

records.key: Edit the page before this one.
records.source: Edit the page before this one.
records.translation: Edita la página anterior a esta.

records.key: Every source pixel
records.source: Every source pixel
records.translation: Cada píxel de origen

records.key: Export settings
records.source: Export settings
records.translation: Ajustes de exportación

records.key: Fields of each chosen well; the selected ones are exported. Drag over fields to select them, Shift-click for a range, Ctrl-click to add or remove one, Ctrl+A for every field, or right-click to select and deselect.
records.source: Fields of each chosen well; the selected ones are exported. Drag over fields to select them, Shift-click for a range, Ctrl-click to add or remove one, Ctrl+A for every field, or right-click to select and deselect.
records.translation: Campos de cada pocillo elegido; se exportan los seleccionados. Arrastre sobre los campos para seleccionarlos, Shift-clic para un intervalo, Ctrl-clic para añadir o quitar uno, Ctrl+A para todos los campos, o clic derecho para seleccionar y deseleccionar.

records.key: Gamma applied after normalization; below 1 lifts faint signal.
records.source: Gamma applied after normalization; below 1 lifts faint signal.
records.translation: Gamma aplicado tras la normalización; por debajo de 1 realza la señal débil.

records.key: Hide the export settings; the canvas keeps every change.
records.source: Hide the export settings; the canvas keeps every change.
records.translation: Oculta los ajustes de exportación; el lienzo conserva cada cambio.

records.key: High percentile
records.source: High percentile
records.translation: Percentil superior

records.key: Hold {keys} and click any image in the Overview to add it to this page.
records.source: Hold {keys} and click any image in the Overview to add it to this page.
records.translation: Mantenga {keys} y haga clic en cualquier imagen de la Vista general para añadirla a esta página.

records.key: Import settings
records.source: Import settings
records.translation: Ajustes de importación

records.key: Low percentile
records.source: Low percentile
records.translation: Percentil inferior

records.key: Most pixels per inch an image is written at; images with fewer pixels keep every pixel. Starts at the figure DPI of Preferences.
records.source: Most pixels per inch an image is written at; images with fewer pixels keep every pixel. Starts at the figure DPI of Preferences.
records.translation: Máximo de píxeles por pulgada con que se escribe una imagen; las imágenes con menos píxeles conservan cada píxel. Parte de los DPI de figura de Preferencias.

records.key: Move the pointer to drag the image onto the canvas.
records.source: Move the pointer to drag the image onto the canvas.
records.translation: Mueva el puntero para arrastrar la imagen al lienzo.

records.key: Normalize and enhance image files added by path or dropped from disk, channel by channel, through the Overview's display pipeline.
records.source: Normalize and enhance image files added by path or dropped from disk, channel by channel, through the Overview's display pipeline.
records.translation: Normaliza y mejora, canal por canal, los archivos de imagen añadidos por ruta o soltados desde el disco, mediante el flujo de visualización de la Vista general.

records.key: Orientation
records.source: Orientation
records.translation: Orientación

records.key: Page {number} of {total}
records.source: Page {number} of {total}
records.translation: Página {number} de {total}

records.key: Page, grid, pages, DPI, layouts and the selected boxes' text, image and import settings, in a popup that applies every change at once.
records.source: Page, grid, pages, DPI, layouts and the selected boxes' text, image and import settings, in a popup that applies every change at once.
records.translation: Página, cuadrícula, páginas, DPI, disposiciones y los ajustes de texto, imagen e importación de los recuadros seleccionados, en una ventana emergente que aplica todos los cambios a la vez.

records.key: Percentile shown as black.
records.source: Percentile shown as black.
records.translation: Percentil que se muestra como negro.

records.key: Percentile shown as full intensity.
records.source: Percentile shown as full intensity.
records.translation: Percentil que se muestra a intensidad completa.

records.key: Place an image file from disk on the page; its import settings then normalize and enhance it.
records.source: Place an image file from disk on the page; its import settings then normalize and enhance it.
records.translation: Coloca un archivo de imagen del disco en la página; sus ajustes de importación lo normalizan y mejoran después.

records.key: Reset import settings
records.source: Reset import settings
records.translation: Restablecer ajustes de importación

records.key: Select all fields
records.source: Select all fields
records.translation: Seleccionar todos los campos

records.key: Sharpen
records.source: Sharpen
records.translation: Enfocar

records.key: Sharpen this channel with an unsharp mask.
records.source: Sharpen this channel with an unsharp mask.
records.translation: Enfoca este canal con una máscara de enfoque.

records.key: Show channel
records.source: Show channel
records.translation: Mostrar canal

records.key: Show the selected files as they are on disk again.
records.source: Show the selected files as they are on disk again.
records.translation: Vuelve a mostrar los archivos seleccionados tal como están en el disco.

records.key: Smooth this channel with a small Gaussian before it is shown.
records.source: Smooth this channel with a small Gaussian before it is shown.
records.translation: Suaviza este canal con un pequeño filtro gaussiano antes de mostrarlo.

records.key: Stretch the channel between the low and high percentiles; off stretches it between its minimum and maximum.
records.source: Stretch the channel between the low and high percentiles; off stretches it between its minimum and maximum.
records.translation: Estira el canal entre los percentiles inferior y superior; desactivado lo estira entre su mínimo y su máximo.

records.key: Subtract a rolling-ball background from this channel.
records.source: Subtract a rolling-ball background from this channel.
records.translation: Resta un fondo de bola rodante de este canal.

records.key: Use the import settings in Settings… to normalize and enhance the added files, channel by channel.
records.source: Use the import settings in Settings… to normalize and enhance the added files, channel by channel.
records.translation: Use los ajustes de importación de Configuración… para normalizar y mejorar los archivos añadidos, canal por canal.

records.key: {dpi} DPI
records.source: {dpi} DPI
records.translation: resolución de {dpi} DPI

records.key: {dpi} DPI (application setting)
records.source: {dpi} DPI (application setting)
records.translation: {dpi} DPI (ajuste de la aplicación)
